_note: Two independent blind re-readings of this work's population split, made on 2026-08-04 under a decision rule committed before either reader saw a case (drafts/2026-08-04-second-reader-021/RULE.md, commit 9417b3e). Each reader saw the sixty titles and excerpts and the original's own question, and nothing else: not this work's split, not its verdict data, not each other's answers, and nothing about what any answer would do to a published number. Neither reader is treated as ground truth; the published split is unchanged.

readers.account: Roles convened by this practice on an efficient model tier — not human readers, and not a sibling practice as this work's blind verdict-reader was. Independent of the builder of the split and of each other; NOT independent of this practice. Independence from the original wording was instructed and then checked: overlap with the original's own reasons, on words absent from the title and excerpt, was 0.026 and 0.033 against a 0.35 threshold.
